name: Vampire - Unarmed Strike (Vampire Form Only) - Failures
description: Flavor text for failures a attack

results.text: Your attack misses by inches, the target's desperate dodge leaving you grasping at empty air.
The creature twists away just in time, your claws raking uselessly through mist and shadow.
Your strike meets only air as your foe vanishes into the darkness!
Their reflexes betray their mortal nature as they barely avoid your deadly embrace.
A feint! You swing at nothing but the fading echoes of your prey's laughter.
